title: R2 v2: время фаз итерации и t_s в истории; замер «до» на 4 случаях Онгудая
goal: В результат solve (R2 v2) добавлены время фаз итерации (mom/heat/proj/kupd/other, мс/итерацию) и стена t_s на каждой проверке; снят замер «до» оптимизации: 4 случая Онгудая × 6/8/18 потоков, u3_heat и u3_mech ещё на 2 и 3 потоках → out/base/.
scope: tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/src/solver.rs — таймеры фаз в solve/outer_step, поля в SolveOut
tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/src/util.rs — только если нужен общий помощник таймера
tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/check_contract.py — --results принимает R2 v1 и v2, для v2 проверяет новые поля и сумму фаз
tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out/base/ — результаты R2 v2 замера «до» и table.py (таблица)
dont_touch: tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/src/main.rs (меняет PR-2; фазы — через SolveOut, result_json берёт их оттуда)

accept.name: clippy
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-1 --no-tmux -- cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings

accept.name: blocks_dev
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-1 --no-tmux -- cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml -- blocks tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/flat_wind.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/agnesi.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/heated_slope.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/saddle.json

accept.name: solve_ref_release
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-1 --no-tmux -- bash -c 'set -e; for c in flat_wind agnesi heated_slope saddle; do tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/$c.json --threads 8 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_${c}_release_t8.json; done' && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/tolerance.py tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_flat_wind_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_agnesi_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_heated_slope_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_saddle_release_t8.json

accept.name: solve_ongudai_release
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-1 --no-tmux -- bash -c 'set -e; for c in ongudai_d400_u3_heat ongudai_d400_u3_mech ongudai_d400_u0_heat ongudai_d400_u6_heat; do tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve ~/data/air_cascade/ongudai/$c.json --threads 8 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_${c}_release_t8.json; done' && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/tolerance.py --iters-tol 10 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u3_heat_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u3_mech_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u0_heat_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u6_heat_release_t8.json

accept.name: phase_sum
accept.cmd: python3 -c "import json,glob; fs=glob.glob('tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out/base/*.json'); w=max(abs(sum(d['time']['phase_ms'].values())/d['time']['ms_per_iter']-1) for d in (json.load(open(f)) for f in fs)); print(f'n={len(fs)}'); print(f'phase_dev={w:.4f}')"

report_extra: timer_overhead: ms_per_iter u3_heat 8 потоков против out/mv/ (AC-R4), %
